sessions.topic: Setup Flutter, Dart refresher, widget tree, dan project structure
sessions.objective: Menyiapkan project dan memahami widget tree serta struktur kode dasar Flutter.
sessions.activity: Doctor check; project setup; stateless/stateful widget; hot reload; folder structure.
sessions.output: Aplikasi awal dan halaman dashboard statis.

sessions.topic: Layout, theming, responsive UI, dan navigation
sessions.objective: Menyusun UI responsif dengan theme dan navigasi antarlayar.
sessions.activity: Row/Column/Flex; constraints; theme; Navigator; route; responsive breakpoint.

sessions.topic: Form, validation, user input, dan state lokal
sessions.objective: Membangun form tervalidasi dan mengelola state lokal secara tepat.
sessions.activity: Form; controller; validator; setState/ChangeNotifier; feedback pengguna.
sessions.output: Form logbook dan daftar entri lokal.

sessions.topic: Async programming, HTTP, JSON, model, dan repository
sessions.objective: Mengambil data API secara asynchronous dan memetakan JSON ke model.
sessions.activity: Future; HTTP client; serialization manual; repository abstraction; timeout.

sessions.topic: State management, loading, error, dan empty state
sessions.objective: Mengelola state aplikasi dan menyajikan loading, error, serta empty state.
sessions.activity: Provider/ChangeNotifier terpandu; state model; retry; pull to refresh.
sessions.output: State lengkap untuk daftar dan detail.

sessions.topic: Local persistence, form submission, dan offline-friendly flow
sessions.objective: Menyimpan data lokal dan mengelola alur submit dengan kegagalan jaringan.
sessions.activity: SharedPreferences/local storage sederhana; optimistic flow; retry queue konsep.

sessions.topic: Testing, integration, build, dan release readiness
sessions.objective: Menulis test dasar, mengintegrasikan fitur, dan menyiapkan build demonstrasi.
sessions.activity: Widget test; service test; integration checklist; app icon/config; build APK/debug.

sessions.topic: Final capstone demo, asesmen akhir, dan retrospective
sessions.objective: Mendemonstrasikan aplikasi end-to-end, menjelaskan kode, dan menyusun rencana pengembangan lanjut.
sessions.activity: Final demo; Q&A; code walkthrough; retrospective; portfolio packaging.
sessions.output: Aplikasi Mobile Logbook Magang dan portofolio program.
sessions.assessment: Asesmen proyek Flutter dan evaluasi akhir.
sessions.evidence: Repository, build, demo video, portfolio index.
